description: A3144 Hall switch: open-collector OUT on PB12 (internal pull-up, EXTI12 both edges), prints 'magnet' / 'no magnet' on every change and mirrors it on the PC13 LED
expect:
72 MHz. PB12 input with pull-up, EXTI12 on both edges; PC13 push-pull (on-board LED, active low) idles high. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'A3144 on PB12 (pull-up, EXTI12)
' then the current state: PB12 low -> 'magnet (OUT low)
' and PC13 low (LED on), PB12 high -> 'no magnet (OUT high)
' and PC13 high. Every EXTI edge wakes the main loop, which prints the new state only when it differs from the last one printed.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
PB12: open (the scenarios pull it low like the A3144's output transistor)

boot.USART1:
A3144 on PB12 (pull-up, EXTI12)
no magnet (OUT high)

scenarios.name: a magnet pulls OUT low for 50 ms
